# PromptPack

> PromptPack (promptpack.tech) is a digital shop run by Ornalens LLP, India. It sells editable AI prompt packs and illustrated PDF field guides for websites, personal finance, social media and video. 5 products have purchase routes, including 3 complete guide editions with free sample prompts.

Updated: 2026-10-18. All products are digital downloads used with the buyer's own AI tools. They do not include AI credits, software subscriptions, recorded courses or publishing services.

## Available now

- [Money Audit Pack](https://promptpack.tech/finance): Find recurring charges in your billing emails. Turn them into a Keep / Review / Compare / Negotiate action plan with your AI assistant. Gmail setup + audit prompts + review worksheets. US$19, or ₹1,599 · one time.
- [75+ Website Prompts](https://promptpack.tech/products/website-prompts/): Website briefs for landing pages, portfolios, SaaS and 3D-style sites. Choose a motion reference, edit the brief and build in your own AI tool. Markdown prompts + motion references. US$8.50, one-time purchase.

## Complete digital guide editions

- [Carousel Studio](https://promptpack.tech/products/carousel-studio/): Design six-slide carousels with a cover that earns the swipe, then plan, approve and publish them. 29-page guide, 28 prompts, starter files. Available for ₹899 (UPI, Indian cards, netbanking or wallets) or US$15 (international cards), paid once through Razorpay. Free sample prompt on the page.
- [UGC Ad Script Kit](https://promptpack.tech/products/ugc-ad-scripts/): Turn an honest product demonstration into a visually directed short ad. 14-page guide, 22 prompts, starter files. Available for ₹699 (UPI, Indian cards, netbanking or wallets) or US$12 (international cards), paid once through Razorpay. Free sample prompt on the page.
- [Juno & Pixel](https://promptpack.tech/products/motion-with-code/): Two-character 3D reels from a 100-word script, made entirely in code. 16-page guide, 20 prompts, starter files. Available for ₹1,499 (UPI, Indian cards, netbanking or wallets) or US$29 (international cards), paid once through Razorpay. Free sample prompt on the page.
